readers.reasoning: The reduction(+: s) appears on both the parallel construct and the gang loop, as required for a reduction spanning loops; the inner j loop is sequential within each gang iteration. s is a scalar named in the parallel reduction clause. hf is written by a single iteration (i==1, j==1), so there is no race. Each gang's partial sum is combined, giving s equal to want (156). The observed s=0 is a compiler error.

The parallel construct carries reduction(+: s), so s has an explicit reduction clause on the compute construct, satisfying the restriction for a loop reduction on s. The gang loop reduction(+: s) gives each gang a private copy; the copies are combined into the original s by the end of the compute region and then into the host s. The inner j loop is sequential, hf is written by one iteration only, and a(i) is read only. The final s is therefore 156, and s=0 is a compiler error.
